newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Paramilitary groups kill eight Colombian peasants.
newsitem.headline: Paramilitary groups kill eight Colombian peasants.

text.p: Suspected members of right-wing paramilitary groups murdered eight peasants in an isolated region of northern Colombia, police said on Monday.

The attack, near the town of La Margarita in Bolivar province, took place sometime between Saturday night and Sunday morning, a police spokesman said. Details of the incident filtered out of the remote community on Monday.
Police said a gang of 15 men, armed with high-powered assault rifles, called the peasants out of their houses by name and shot them.
More than 200 people have been killed by right-wing paramilitaries in the last four months across northern Colombia, records show.
The gangs have been quoted as claiming a self-declared mission to combat leftist guerrillas and their sympathisers. Human rights groups accuse the military of backing the death squads.
